g.text: Opaque: the post-quantum security layer for Ethereum
orange: Opaque · grey: Ethereum and others, unchanged · every orange box that acts does so only on a FORS+C signature, checked in the core
no bundler, no paymaster: the account pays its own gas
FORS+C keys · PQKeyRegistry · at most 8 signatures a key, then the next · hash-based
